discipline: One fixed 15% incremental factor weight only; no blend-weight, formula, threshold or cap scan
No paper target or order file

disclosure: R347 replacement results were observed before this R348 preregistration. R348 is therefore explicitly post-hoc and tests only one fixed incremental blend: old four C legs scaled by 0.85 and the solvency factor added at 15%. No weight, formula, threshold or cap scan is allowed. The coverage-only R348 preflight inspected coverage and correlations only; no R348 return, drawdown, trade or concentration metric was inspected before this file was frozen.
economic_rationale: R347 showed that the solvency factor is not a substitute for low-vol: replacement reduced C standalone annual return by 1.40pp and deepened C standalone MDD by 2.95pp. The factor still carries partly independent information (mean daily Spearman 0.4786 versus low-vol, 0.2938 versus quality), so R348 tests it strictly as an incremental fifth leg with no weight search.

hypothesis: Keeping the original C quality-momentum-low-vol legs and adding a 15% industry-neutral solvency buffer improves C standalone risk-adjusted return and preserves the R344 portfolio gates, whereas replacing low-vol in R347 did not.
known_limitations: The book-equity/volatility ratio is not a full Merton distance-to-default model.
Financial firms are handled by within-industry neutralization rather than a separate credit model.
Current-snapshot industry classification is backfilled through history.
Membership is reconstructed and ETF qfq is not official PIT total return.
The common window starts in 2022 because TTM financial factors are unavailable earlier.
The 10% C cap, broad C design and gold trend rule were selected in prior post-hoc research.
R348 is post-hoc after observing R347 results and is not an independent out-of-sample discovery.

prior_failed_experiment.lesson: The solvency factor did not replace low-vol: C standalone annual fell from 1.4851% to 0.0830% and MDD worsened from -28.89% to -31.84%.

reference_control.use: fixed comparison construction; R344 remains a failed/no-candidate result and is not relabelled

selection_rule: All D/G/T/X/C/R/F/P gates must pass. Otherwise record the result as research-only negative evidence and do not promote or generate paper targets. No threshold, weight, cap or window changes after results.

added_component.neutralization: industry_l1 demean plus within-industry z-score; all four original C scoring legs are excluded from neutralization
